searchText: What's the status of the development of the EIP 1559 fee-market mechanism? Is it currently being implemented or is it still in research phase? <@!396080847540977665> Implemented in two clients, currently running a testnet together. 👍 <@!301186049323958275> Nice. When is it expected to be released on main-net? I'm *hoping* for fork after next, but it may not make the cut. That would be 6-12 months away. Hoping for soft fork Ohh, I assume that the gas prices will continue to increase until then... This can't be done with a soft fork and won't provide a 10x reduction in gas prices. Apologies for being blunt, but I want to make sure that people don't stop pushing for other solutions to help with gas prices hoping 1559 will fix it 😅 > expected_base_fee = parent_base_fee - parent_base_fee * extra_gas_available // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR this seems right Except the rounding biases toward 0 so I think you would want the minimum gas fee to be `BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR * 2` at least So `assert expected_base_fee == max(block.base_fee, BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR * 2)`
